## Meridian Quay Conference Hotel — Guest Room Rate Sheet

### Corner Studio | Corporate Saver
Maximum occupancy: 3 guests. Bed configuration: one queen bed and one sofa bed. Included services: wired and wireless internet, daily parking for one vehicle, and access to the business lounge from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Rate: GBP 219.50 per room per night. Cancellation: free cancellation up to 48 hours before 3:00 p.m. on the arrival date; cancellations after that deadline incur the first night's charge. Payment: the first night's charge is collected at booking; the remaining balance is payable at check-in.
